belongs_to: Distributive property text: "Consider 10 × 98 + 3 × 98. This means taking the sum of 10 times 98 and 3 times 98."
description: One printed line of repeated addition of 98, 13 copies of 98 in all, joined by plus signs: "98 + 98 + 98 + 98 + 98 + 98 + 98 + 98 + 98 + 98" (10 copies), then a slightly wider gap, then "+ 98 + 98 + 98" (3 more copies). Below the line, a curly brace (opening upwards, point of the brace at the middle, below) spans exactly the first 10 copies of 98 and carries the label "10 times" under its point.
